records.text: Tyler Robinson may have gone to his grandmother's house after leaving Cowboy Smokehouse.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: So when I spoke to the people who had reported this, they suspect, and I think this is a good suspicion, a good instinct to follow, that he may have gone to his grandma's house afterwards

records.text: Tyler Robinson's grandmother said that he did not fire guns and did not commit Charlie Kirk's murder.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #3 (Ep HYn0P-P1wUw)

appearances.snippet: And you have the wrong person. She said, my grandson does not fire guns. My grandson did not commit this murder.

verification.notes: Contemporaneous reporting directly quotes Robinson's grandmother saying he never handled or owned a gun and that she did not believe he killed Kirk.
